verdict.rationale: Sardine's marketing pages describe built-in AI agents that clear false-positive sanctions matches, do supporting research, and route higher-risk matches to analysts. They also claim 'Agentic AML Ops' agents that automate KYC/AML alert reviews and investigations. That is genuine in-product agentic work, but it is limited to fixed compliance workflows, and nothing shows an assistant a user can hand arbitrary tasks to. Missing for 10: an interactive or general-purpose assistant users can delegate tasks to, docs on how users invoke and steer the agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing claims.
